instructions.primary_message: Spray the bottom and sides of an 9-inch loaf pan with cooking spray. Cut a 4 x 13-inch piece of parchment paper, then press it into the length of the pan, covering the bottom and the short sides. Lightly spray the bottom of the pan once more, then cut an 8 x 14-inch piece of parchment paper and press it into the pan, covering the bottom and long sides (the paper will overhang the long sides by about 2 1/2 inches; this with be used to cover the top of the cake while it is in the freezer).
Place tea biscuits in a large bowl. Using your hands or a wooden spoon, roughly break the biscuits into large pieces. Set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, cut butter into small pieces. Place in a medium heat-proof bowl along with both types of chocolate chips.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, salted
½ cup milk chocolate chips
½ cup dark chocolate chips

instructions.primary_message: Once the water is boiling, uncover the pan and place the bowl with the butter and chocolate chips over the simmering water, allowing it to sit on the rim. Using a silicone spatula, stir continuously, until just melted and smooth. Remove from heat.
Add sweetened condensed milk and cocoa powder to the bowl, then whisk to combine the chocolate mixture.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (397 g) can sweetened condensed milk
¼ cup cocoa powder

instructions.primary_message: Add biscuits to the bowl with the chocolate mixture, then gently stir to combine.

Transfer the chocolate-biscuit mixture to the loaf pan, then use the silicone spatula to smooth the top. Gently pull the overhanging parchment paper over the top of the cake to cover. Place loaf pan in the freezer until cake is set, about 1 hour.

When the cake is set, remove from freezer. Holding the excess parchment paper on the sides, carefully lift the cake out of the pan and invert onto a cutting board; discard parchment paper. Cut cake crosswise into slices.
Arrange cake slices on a serving platter and enjoy!
